name: What is waterproof coating and why is it important for buildings?

mainEntity.name: What is waterproof coating and why is it important for buildings?

acceptedAnswer.text: Waterproof coating is a protective layer applied to surfaces like roofs, foundations, and walls to prevent water penetration. It forms a barrier against moisture, protecting the structural integrity of a building from water damage, mold growth, and efflorescence. This is crucial in areas prone to rain or high humidity, as it extends the lifespan of building materials and helps maintain indoor air quality by preventing dampness. It also contributes to energy efficiency by preventing moisture-related insulation degradation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproof coating is a protective layer that stops water from entering a building, preventing damage, mold, and extending material life.
